generalPolicies.earlyCheckinPolicy: Early check-in is subject to availability of the rooms upon request (complimentary from 10:00 AM); guaranteed early morning check-in requires room reservation from the preceding night.
generalPolicies.lateCheckoutPolicy: Late check-out is subject to availability of the rooms upon request; 24-hour complimentary secure luggage storage is always provided.
generalPolicies.checkoutProcedure: Guests must submit their room keys at the reception, sign the official entry/departure register, and clear all pending bills and dues before leaving the hotel.
generalPolicies.stayExtensionPolicy: In case of a stay extension, guests must inform the reception in advance and check that day's room price. The hotel reserves the right to apply on-that-day room rates, and stay extensions are subject to room availability.
generalPolicies.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation is permitted up to 24-48 hours prior to the scheduled check-in date. Cancellations made within the late cancellation window incur a 1-night room charge.
generalPolicies.childPolicy: Children up to 5 years stay free sharing existing bed with parents. For children aged 6 to 12 years, extra bed is ₹1,000 INR per night (Room Only) or ₹1,200 INR per night with breakfast.
generalPolicies.extraAdultPolicy: Extra adult (12+ years) is ₹2,000 INR per night with roll-away extra bed included.
generalPolicies.freePickupPolicy: Complimentary airport arrival pick-up service is provided exclusively for Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGI Airport – T1, T2, T3) on direct bookings accepted and reconfirmed by the hotel reservation team (dependent upon the room package booked) or eligible bookings via Booking.com. Railway station arrivals (including New Delhi Railway Station NDLS) are strictly not eligible for complimentary pickup. The service is provided on the strict condition that the mandatory airport commercial parking fee of ₹485 INR is borne directly by the guest. Up to 30 minutes driver waiting time from flight touchdown is included; delays exceeding 30 minutes require the guest to pay actual incurred parking authority charges. Guests must provide their flight details, booking confirmation number, and arrival date at least 24 hours prior (no last-minute requests). The complimentary pickup cannot be switched or exchanged for an airport drop because the contract with our third-party travel agency is exclusively for inbound pickups; airport departure drop is chargeable in all cases.
generalPolicies.outsideFoodPolicy: Outside food and online food deliveries (Swiggy, Zomato, etc.) are strictly prohibited in guest rooms and dining areas under FSSAI and hotel hygiene guidelines. In-house cutlery and crockery will not be provided for outside food. 24-hour in-house room service is available.
generalPolicies.minimumAgePolicy: The primary guest for individual bookings must be at least 18 years of age. Valid physical government-issued photo identification is mandatory for all adult guests at check-in.
generalPolicies.localIdPolicy: Local IDs (Delhi address proof) are strictly not accepted for check-in under hotel security regulations. In case of any booking made under this condition, check-in will be denied and no refund will be applicable.
generalPolicies.couplePolicy: Valid original physical government-issued photo ID (Passport, Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License) is required for all adult guests at check-in (PAN cards not accepted). Local Delhi residents are not accepted.
generalPolicies.petPolicy: Godwin Hotels does not allow pets in guest rooms or dining areas, with the exception of certified service animals.
generalPolicies.alcoholPolicy: No liquor is served in our restaurant, café, or dining areas. Guests cannot drink alcohol or smoke in public spaces or common areas of the hotel premises. Guests are permitted to bring legal liquor from outside and enjoy it privately inside their room.
generalPolicies.smokingPolicy: Smoking is strictly prohibited in all public spaces, corridors, dining halls, and indoor rooms. Designated outdoor rooftop smoking zones are provided.
generalPolicies.partiesAndDecorationsPolicy: No parties, celebrations, or room decorations are allowed in guest rooms. For hosting or arranging any such celebration or event, guests must speak with hotel management in advance.
generalPolicies.photographyPolicy: No photography or videography is allowed within the hotel premises without prior permission from hotel management.
generalPolicies.buffetBreakfastPrice: ₹550 INR per person per day (served daily 07:30 AM – 10:30 AM at the Rooftop Restaurant).
generalPolicies.groupLunchDinnerPrice: ₹850 INR per person (Group Rate for Lunch or Dinner buffets).
generalPolicies.diningPolicy: 24-hour in-house room service is available for all guests to order fresh food in their room at any time of day or night. Daily buffet breakfast is served at the Rooftop Restaurant from 07:30 AM to 10:30 AM at ₹550 INR per person per day (included in Bed & Breakfast plans). Group lunch and dinner buffets are available at ₹850 INR per person. The Indian Grill is open daily from 07:30 AM to 11:00 PM (last order taken at 10:45 PM). Coffee Brownie boutique cafe is open daily from 08:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
generalPolicies.parkingPolicy: Valet parking assistance and secure parking arrangements are provided for registered hotel guests.
